No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you're ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.
Get To Know Our Team
The Global Service Delivery (GSD) team is responsible for Agoda's office infrastructure and staff connectivity. We provide the hardware, software, and access to resources that allow staff to achieve their goals. We operate in 10 different countries, providing 24/7 support to all Agoda employees. Whether in the office, working remotely, or traveling, we enable everyone to stay connected. The GSD team uses state-of-the-art cloud management technologies combined with the best on-site services to manage the latest hardware running Windows, macOS, and Linux.
The Opportunity:
Agoda is using a wide range of systems and tools like Workday, Zendesk, Greenhouse, etc. to support its People operations' fast-moving pace and dynamic workforce needs globally. We are looking for a People Technology Manager (Integrations) to drive projects and implement solutions at scale to simplify work, automate repetitive tasks, and optimize business processes. In this role, you will be a key driver of Agoda's People Technology strategy, owning critical integrations and automations that directly impact every employee's experience. You'll work at the intersection of HR, Payroll, and Technology, with the freedom to innovate and the scale to see your solutions make a measurable difference
In This Role, You'll Get To
Lead a team of SMEs to drive People Technology integration projects.
Own and lead Agoda's payroll integration roadmap, shaping how core HR and payroll systems work together across countries and products.
Strategize Agoda's Workday integration roadmap by scaling solutions, driving continuous improvements, and assessing platform readiness.
Lead integration design strategy using Workday and other tools, integrating with platforms such as Zendesk, Greenhouse, Oracle, and other components of the Agoda tech stack.
Optimize existing automated solutions to improve efficiency and create leaner processes.
Partner closely with key business stakeholders (Payroll, FinSys, People Technology, BI Dev) to assess technology needs and feasibility, align priorities, manage timelines, and drive end-to-end delivery from design through testing and deployment.
Explore creative and out-of-the-box solutions to solve complex business problems.
Implement, test, and launch major system enhancements, ensuring quality, stability, and a smooth change experience for end users.
Collaborate with solutions and engineering teams to design and implement custom applications and tools that extend Workday and the broader People Tech ecosystem.
Mentor and coach junior team members, sharing best practices and elevating the overall technical capabilities of the team.
Lead system-related training and demos for Agoda employees and People Team end users, driving adoption of new tools, features, and ways of working.
What You'll Need to Succeed:
Minimum +8 years of hands-on Workday Integrations experience
Experience managing and leading a team
Proven track record leading technical implementations for payroll integration rollouts, specifically using PECI
Strong expertise with Workday integration and reporting tools, including Workday Studio, EIB, Core Connectors, PECI, BIRT, RaaS, and REST/SOAP API-based integrations
Solid knowledge of Workday Core HCM and other key functional/technical areas, such as Business Processes, Security, and system configuration
Deep understanding of integration design patterns, error handling, and Workday data models
Comfortable working in ambiguous environments, proactively identifying and resolving edge cases, dependencies, and potential risks
Strong team player with a high sense of ownership, bringing subject-matter expertise while collaborating to solve complex issues
Demonstrated ability to drive continuous improvements to simplify processes, increase scalability, and reduce operational complexity
Strong project and stakeholder management skills, with experience engaging cross-functional teams
Ability to leverage data and analytics to generate insights and support effective decision-making
Fluency in English, both written and spoken, is required
It's Great If You Have:
Experience in automation tools and programming languages outside of Workday space (MS Power Apps, SQL, HTML)
Ability to constructively challenge and refine requests while maintaining respectful, professional relationships
Presentation/Workshop facilitation
Able to move fast, adapt to changes

title: Senior Technical Specialist – Well Testing
description:
Airswift is looking for a Senior Technical Specialist – Well Testing (Hybrid and Offshore)
to work on a 12-month assignment in Rio de Janeiro with a major oil and gas company.
The Professional will provide specialized technical support in deepwater exploration and appraisal well testing to the well team in Brazil. The Senior Well Testing Technical Specialist will be responsible for technical design, detailed engineering, and operational supervision activities in the field to safely and reliably design, plan, and execute E&A well testing scopes in Brazil, in compliance with all local regulations and relevant company and industry standards. The professional will work with a multidisciplinary and international team to ensure the safe delivery of all technical and commercial objectives for the complex and challenging deepwater E&A well testing scopes. This will include, among other activities, addressing process safety and operational risks, providing reliable technical engineering designs, developing detailed operational procedures, and providing supervision and monitoring of offshore operations at the well site.
Job Responsibilities
In this role the Senior Technical Specialist – Well Testing will:
Work as part of a team, under the direction of the Well Discipline Lead and Regional Wells Superintendent
Promote a strong safety culture across all well testing activities, focusing on inherently safer designs, process safety, procedural discipline, adherence to standards and collaboration with key stakeholders
Manage and work collaboratively with well testing and drilling teams and associated contractors to develop safe and reliable designs and robust and detailed operational procedures.
Lead and coordinate management of regional resources and activity with direct input from regional and functional management and engineering teams.
Oversight of contractual and technical conformance of the service providers and ensuring time and cost budgets are accurately forecasted and spending is appropriately monitored and controlled.
Review operational failure incidents, analyse root cause effects and present findings to ensure a positive learning culture.
Write deep technical reports, basis of designs, well programmes, work instructions and other documentation in English and be computer literate with relevant office and technical software packages
Manage and support HAZard IDentification, HAZard OPerability studies and Layers Of Protection Analysis, HSE risk assessments, well operations reviews, certification and design engineering reviews.
Integrate service providers and client demands to deliver safe, efficient and compliant operations.
Interface with the rig personnel on preparation of SIMOPS, TWOPs and safety critical and operational procedures.
Provide onshore logistical and operational support for regional activity as required.
Report directly to and provide technical support and safety advice to the Well Site Leaders during offshore execution
Lead and supervise site based Well Testing and related operations as required; ensuring systems are installed, commissioned and operated as per approved design and programme.
Provide quality control and quality assurance for all the well test and fluid data acquisition activities at site.
Perform end of well reporting and financial reconciliation, capturing lessons learnt and driving continuous improvement plans and initiatives.
Job Qualifications
Experience in deepwater well testing, including experience in operators and the service sector in the design, planning, and direct supervision of deepwater exploration and appraisal (E&A) well testing operations. Prior experience in process safety, including HAZIDs, HAZOPs, and LOPAs, and their application in improving the safety and reliability of well testing operations. Prior experience in design assurance and supervision of safety systems and critical safety equipment for deepwater, subsea, and surface well testing.
Bachelor's degree required.
Advanced English - Required.
Valid Well Control Certificate (WellSharp or IWCF).
BOSIET or HUET training applicable for locations requiring helicopter transport to the well.
About Airswift
Airswift serves as a strategic partner to our clients in STEM industries. We offer a turnkey workforce solution to acquire, mobilise and employ top talent in over 70 countries. With 800 employees in over 60 offices worldwide, 7,000 contractors and a candidate database of 1.5m specialists, our geographical reach and pool of available talent, experience and expertise is unmatched in the industry. We are proud to serve as a trusted advisor to clients looking to expand their operations internationally and offer employer of record services, payroll outsourcing, as well as HR consulting.

title: Quality Control Inspector
description:
JOB TITLE: QC Inspector – WAG Manifolds
CLIENT: Global Energy Operator
LOCATION: Rio, Brazil
ASSIGNMENT TYPE: Residential
START DATE: ASAP
CONTRACT LENGTH: Annually Renewable Contract
MISSIONS / SERVICE DIMENSIONS
The Service Provider will deliver QC services at the WAG (Water Alternate Gas) manifolds worksite based in Rio, Brazil, with frequent travel to Distrito Industrial – Vespasiano/MG. The role ensures the Contractor supplies WAG Manifolds and Foundations on schedule, in compliance with CLIENT HSE policies and required quality standards.
ACTIVITIES
The Service Provider will liaise with:
CPY Subsea HSE Lead
CPY Quality Lead
CPY Materials & Welding Lead
CPY Delivery Lead
HSE AND COMPLIANCE – THE SERVICE HOLDER SHALL:
Fully comply with site security, health, and safety requirements and maintain continuous hazard awareness
Demonstrate exemplary H3SE behaviour, complete required training, and follow CPY Subsea HSE Lead directives
Report issues/anomalies through site systems and apply STOP WORK when necessary
Ensure risk assessments and toolbox talks are performed effectively
Comply with Company Ethics and Code of Conduct, supporting Anti-Corruption initiatives
WORK TASKS
The Service Holder will ensure that work performed by CTR and sub-contractors complies with CPY and Project Specifications for WAG Manifolds and Foundations. Responsibilities include:
Conduct inspection of welds and welding processes in accordance with WPS/PQR, codes, standards, and specifications
Perform inspections before, during, and after welding per ISO requirements
Apply extensive inspection experience (minimum 10 years) with CRA materials: Super Duplex (Pipe/Forging/HIPPED), Inconel 625, and LAS (F22)
Inspect buttering, overlay, and girth welding using Inconel 625 and Alloy 59 consumables
Perform advanced NDT methods:
Visual
Ultrasonic
PAUT (Phased Array UT)
Magnetic Particle
Liquid Penetrant
Verify testing in accordance with ASME and DNV requirements
Review WPS and PQR to validate production compliance
Inspect incoming materials against specifications and mill certificates
Participate in root cause analysis for welding defects and implement corrective actions
Identify and report deviations or quality issues impacting SPS equipment
Prepare weekly inspection reports
Coordinate with Company Site Representative and CPY Material Engineer on welding, NDT, and materials matters
Stop work in case of non-conformity and reassess prior to restart
Agree practical solutions with contractors that maintain quality without impacting schedule
Ensure timely closure of non-conformities
Monitor site welding activities and provide feedback to the project team
Participate in audits and follow up on corrective actions
CONTEXT & ENVIRONMENT
The service supports the execution phase of a major offshore development project. The multidisciplinary project team manages subsea systems, FPSO integration, and reservoir development.
Project objectives include:
Maximising economic performance
Optimising schedule, cost, and emissions
Maintaining high technical quality and H3SE standards
DURATION / LOCATION
Start Date: 1 March 2026
Duration: 1 year (renewable through fabrication until mid-2028)
Location: Rio, Brazil, with frequent travel to Distrito Industrial – Vespasiano/MG
Status: Residential
QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE REQUIRED
Experience with WAG Manifolds and subsea structures
15+ years of welding inspection experience
Certification as Welding Inspector: CWI / CSWIP 3.1 or 3.2 (or equivalent)
NDT Level 3 certification (UT & PAUT, RT, DPI)
Strong ability to interpret engineering drawings and specifications
Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills
Fluent English required (Portuguese and/or French an advantage)

title: Motorista Operador de Munk
description:
DESCRIÇÃO DA VAGA
Executar serviços referentes a condução de máquinas móveis para o transporte de cargas em área industrial, cumprindo as políticas, diretrizes e práticas operacionais e de gestão, a fim de garantir a execução dos serviços com máxima segurança.
Atividades
Dirigir e operar caminhão equipado com guincho tipo munk, zelando pela segurança da operação;
Operar o veículo com peso limite estabelecido observando os requisitos de segurança;
Assegura que a carga está corretamente disposta e amarrada;
Dirigir o caminhão em conformidade com a Lei;
Verificar a necessidade de abastecimento dos veículos ou outros procedimentos, evitando atrasos ou paradas;
Registrar os dados relativos à quilometragem, consumo de combustível, avarias e outros quando solicitados pela administração da Empresa;
Zelar pelo funcionamento e conservação da máquina, tomando as providências necessárias à sua manutenção;
Solicitar apoio de um Auxiliar na carga e descarga, sempre que necessário;
Cuidar da ordem e conservação do veículo (lubrificação, limpeza, etc.) e solicitar serviços de manutenção preventiva ou corretiva quando necessário;
Atender aos procedimentos de segurança na condução do veículo.

Ensino Médio Completo;
Experiência na função;
CNH cat D;
Curso de operador de munk / movimentação de carga.

title: Técnico(a) de Serviços
description:
Resumo do cargo:
O Técnico de Serviços proporciona suporte técnico qualificado à base instalada do cliente, conseguindo a satisfação do cliente através da execução dos serviços e contratos de acordo com o escopo e orçamento definido.
Nesse cargo, suas responsabilidades serão:
Assessoramento na elaboração e no cumprimento de programas de manutenção corretiva, preventiva e preditiva, além de assessoria técnica nas intervenções nos sitemas Emerson Machine Automation Solutions (antiga GE Automation & Controls);
Levantamento de dados, elaboração de fluxogramas , diagramas, memórias de cálculo e de estudos, visando a seleção do equipamento, material, execução de um projeto ou a adoção da solução mais econômica para resolução de problemas em instalações industriais de automação, existentes;
Elaboração de projetos básicos contendo Procedimentos Técnicos, Memoriais Descritivos de Construção e Montagem e de Memoriais Descritivos para Contratação de Projetos Executivos, obedecendo aos padrões da PETROBRAS;
Análise de projetos e estudos técnicos de outras empresas, bem como a emissão de Pareceres Técnicos (PATEC) de equipamentos e serviços que envolvam equipamento Emerson;
Serviços para configuração, programação e atualização (i.e. softwares, ladder, hardware, firmware, etc) dos Sistemas de Automação Emerson das Instalações de Produção da PETROBRAS, englobando computadores, redes de comunicação de dados e equipamentos de controle e intertravamento, tais como controladores lógicos programáveis da Emerson (PACSystems RX3i, Versamax, Series 9030 e 9070);
Gerenciamento, monitoração e suporte para supervisórios da GE Digital (implementados ou não em conjunto com PLC da Emerson);
Elaboração, desenvolvimento e execução de projetos de migração de sistemas com equipamentos Emerson descontinuados (obsoletos);
Realizar auditoria técnica nos equipamentos e aplicativos do fabricante, asim como gerenciamento e planejamento de sobressalentes e estoque de equipamentos dos Sistemas de Automação Industrial Emerson;
Comissionamento de novas tecnologias para os sistemas Emerson de Automação Industrial.
Quem você é:
Você distingue prontamente entre o que é relevante e o que é irrelevante para compreender situações complexas. Você encontra pontos em comum e conduz as coisas para o consenso, garantindo que todos se sintam ouvidos. Você utiliza insights dos clientes para impulsionar e orientar o desenvolvimento de novas ofertas. Você age de forma rápida e decisiva em situações imprevisíveis e que mudam constantemente.
Para este cargo, você precisará:
Formação Técnica em Automação;
Ter experiência comprovada na área de automação industrial, sendo 2 anos na área de óleo e gás (offshore);
Capacidade de interpretar especificações, programas e desenhos técnicos de sistemas de automação;
Conhecimento avançado no pacote MS Office;
Desejável conhecimento do portfólio de produtos da Emerson, tais como: PACSystems RX3i, VersaMax, QuickPanel+, Machine Edition etc;
Capacidade de especificar, dar suporte e manutenção, e elaborar arquiteturas de redes de automação industrial envolvendo switches, firewalls e rádios industriais;
Disponibilidade para viagens para visitar instalações e escritórios do cliente;
Disponibilidade para trabalho embarcado em plataformas de petróleo, no regime de trabalho 14 x 14;
Local de trabalho: Rio de Janeiro - RJ;
Idiomas: Português e Inglês avançado.
Qualificações preferenciais que o diferenciam:
Nossa Cultura e compromisso com você:
Na Emerson, priorizamos um local de trabalho onde todos os colaboradores sejam valorizados, respeitados e capacitados para crescer. Promovemos um ambiente que incentiva a inovação, a colaboração e perspectivas diversas, porque sabemos que grandes ideias vêm de grandes equipes. Nosso compromisso com o desenvolvimento contínuo da carreira e o crescimento de uma cultura inclusiva garantem que você tenha o apoio para prosperar. Seja por meio de orientação, treinamento ou oportunidades de liderança, investimos no seu sucesso para que você possa causar um impacto duradouro. Acreditamos que equipes diversas, trabalhando juntas, são fundamentais para impulsionar o crescimento e entregar resultados de negócios.

Acreditamos na responsabilidade em contribuir para uma sociedade mais justa, inclusiva e com igualdade de oportunidades, por isso, todas as nossas vagas estão abertas a pessoas de diferentes perfis e contextos, inclusive pessoas com deficiência.

title: Piping and Pressure Vessels Engineer
description:
Imagine your career taking you to the depths of innovation and the heights of impact.  Our people enable continuous progress. Their commitment, collective expertise, and unique capabilities are the engine room behind SBM Offshore's True. Blue. Transition. - shaping the future of energy, and beyond.
About Us:
SBM Offshore is the world's deepwater ocean-infrastructure expert. Our work is already resulting in cleaner, more efficient energy production. True. Blue. Transition. is our promise to enable that into the future while at the same time using our expertise to support new and existing markets in the blue economy. It starts with Advancing our Core: continuing to advance the decarbonization of traditional energy production. While Pioneering More: helping to enable the energy transition and using our unique capabilities in ocean infrastructure to support more industries to grow sustainably.  Sharing our experience for a better blue tomorrow.

Purpose


  • You are responsible for ensuring the effective integrity of piping systems and pressure vessels on Floating Production Storage and Offloading (FPSO) units.

    • Responsibilities


  • You act in the integrity on-board FPSOs for Pressure systems (Piping, Pressure Vessel, hoses, and tubing).
  • You are responsible for the execution of the scopes for all equipment controlled, piping and pressure vessels in particular, including predictive maintenance, condition monitoring, quality assurance and quality control of subcontractors.
  • You ensure legal compliance, national regulatory requirements and keep certifications based on national or international standards and ordinances.
  • You ensure preparation, implementation, and monitoring of inspection plans of piping and pressure vessels controlled equipment, and organization of related activities with equipment inspector.
  • You define inspection techniques to guarantee the physical integrity of piping and pressure vessels. Implement new inspection technologies, and methodologies, special tests, engineering studies, etc.
  • You analyze the in-service piping and pressure vessels structural integrity through inspections and nondestructive tests, assessment for fitness for service or risk-based inspection to determine if the equipment is fit for continued service.
  • You embark in the operational units might be required for these activities to comply with local requirements.
  • You prepare, review, and approve inspection records, ensuring that are conclusive in accordance with the company procedures, standards, integrity management system, national legislation and ordinances, to attend certifications.
  • You approve, control, reassess and manage the inspection technical recommendations related to piping and pressure vessels inspections.
  • You support the frame agreement negotiations with subcontractors dealing with the activies in Piping and Pressure Vessel.
  • You collect KPIs to maintain the overall dashboard for Asset Integrity execution, inspection and monitoring.
  • You support the Asset Integrity Piping & Pressure Vessel specification for the new units.
  • You review annual inspection campaigns relative to the discipline.

    • Education


  • Bachelor Degree in Mechanical or Naval Engineering Disciplines, or equivalent.

    • Experience


  • Experience in the field inspection of piping and pressure vessels, following national and international standards and ordinances.
  • Extensive knowledge in design and Engineering as per process piping international standard (B31.3).
  • Extensive knowledge of pipe construction and piping repair techniques is a plus.
  • Extensive knowledge of Risk Based Inspection (RBI) methodology and standards is a plus.
  • Extensive knowledge in piping specification such as piping material class, material data sheet.
  • Design skill in Plant Desig Management System (PDMS) or Naviswork softwares.
  • Master's degree or Post-Graduation in a relevant subject to the activities (e.g. Metallurgical/Corrosion) or relevant certification in correlated areas is considered a competitive edge.
  • Be active with any mandatory registration and certifications required by national regulatory standards

    • Functional Competencies


    Piping - Piping Materials Monitoring performance and compliance Regulatory Management Inspection, testing, commissioning and monitoring Learning from events Piping - Stress and Supports Piping - Risk Based Inspection Internal Audit Delivery Mechanical Static Equipment - Pressure Vessel Planning

  • Elaborar e encaminhar o Relatório de Glosas quinzenal ou mensal, à Supervisão Imediata, favorecendo o acompanhamento do processamento das contas médicas;

  • Cumprir os cronogramas específicos, observando as respectivas datas e procedimentos indispensáveis para o fechamento do processo;
  • Conhecer os planos ofertados pela PASA – Plano de Assistência à Saúde do Aposentado da Vale, visando à divulgação e esclarecimento dúvidas sobre a Associação entre os aposentados e empregados das empresas do Grupo Vale;
  • Responder pela qualidade, confiabilidade e desempenho dos recursos, serviços e informações geradas pelas tarefas sob sua responsabilidade.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Ensino Médio completo;
  • Pacote Office, desejável Excel Intermediário;
  • Sistema Informatizado de Processamento de Contas Médicas;
  • Noções de Tabelas de Planos de Saúde;
  • Conhecimento de processamento de contas hospitalares, ambulatoriais e média complexidade com atuação mínima de 24 meses.

Informações adicionais

Informações adicionais:

  • VT conforme necessidade com desconto de 4% sobre o salário;
  • VR no valor de R$19,90 por dia trabalhado com desconto de 5% sobre o valor fornecido;
  • Plano de Saúde (apenas titular) com desconto fixo de R$0,01,sendo Amil 400 QC Nacional;
  • Seguro de vida sem desconto.

Somos uma Associação na qual as pessoas podem confiar. Confiar suas vidas, suas famílias e o seu futuro. Somos um benefício exclusivo, que oferece um serviço atencioso de qualidade para todos que fizeram e fazem parte da empresa Vale. A exclusividade de ter mais do que um plano de saúde tem nome e se chama: PASA.

O Plano de Assistência de Saúde ao Aposentado Vale (PASA) foi criado em 1991 como forma de garantir que os aposentados da companhia e seus familiares continuassem a desfrutar de um atendimento de alto nível na área da saúde. A operadora superou as melhores expectativas e se tornou uma iniciativa de sucesso no segmento de autogestão.

Nossa missão é "Oferecer o melhor cuidado com o máximo de carinho"

Agimos de maneira acolhedora e buscamos que todas as pessoas se sintam seguras e confiantes em fazer parte do PASA. Nosso intuito é proporcionar que cada pessoa aproveite o melhor da vida, sem preocupações com o acesso à saúde.

Com o esforço conjunto de mais de 300 empregados, trabalhamos para que os associados e usuários tenham acesso às mais modernas inovações da medicina, ao menor custo possível, de modo que o PASA continue a cumprir com êxito a missão que lhe foi dada por seus visionários fundadores. Nossos principais objetivos para os próximos anos são:

  • Cuidar das pessoas
  • Vanguarda na gestão da saúde
  • Instituição com ação perene
  • Cliente no centro

At BairesDev, we've been leading the way in technology projects for over 15 years. We deliver cutting-edge solutions to giants like Google and the most innovative startups in Silicon Valley.

Our diverse 4,000+ team, composed of the world's Top 1% of tech talent, works remotely on roles that drive significant impact worldwide.

Learning Operations Analyst at BairesDev

  • You are comfortable working with data, systems, and operational workflows.

title: Team Lead
description:
We are looking for the right people - people who want to innovate, achieve, grow and lead. We attract and retain the best talent by investing in our employees and empowering them to develop themselves and their careers. Experience the challenges, rewards and opportunity of working for one of the world's largest providers of products and services to the global energy industry.

Job Duties
We are building a platform that merges real-time physics, structured knowledge, and autonomous intelligence. You will be the technical anchor for a team of Senior Engineers handling:

  • Backend: Ingesting massive sensor streams and running multi-agent AI systems.
  • Data: Organizing tons of industrial data into a Medallion Architecture.
  • Frontend: Building the "Control Room" and complex AI interfaces.
  • DevOps: Deploying across hybrid cloud (AWS/Azure) and edge (K3s) environments.

Your challenge is to ensure these distinct pieces fit together. ensuring the backend model is consumable by the frontend's "Visualizations" and that the "Data Pipelines" are reliably deployed by DevOps.

What You'll Do

  • Technical Orchestration: You will drive cross-boundary architectural decisions. You will decide how the Backend serves live telemetry to Frontend dashboards and how Data Engineering pipelines feed the Knowledge Graph.
  • Code & Quality Standards: Enforce high standards across the stack. You will review API designs (FastAPI), ensure the Frontend maintains strict Component Architecture, and verify that Data pipelines implement appropriate quality gates.
  • The "Expert": When the DevOps engineer faces a connectivity issue between Cloud and On-Prem, or the Backend engineer struggles with concurrency in a distributed stream, you are the senior voice in the room, guiding the solution.
  • Team Leadership: Conduct code reviews, mentor senior developers, and translating high-level product requirements into technical tasks (ADO) for the squad.

The Technology Stack
You do not need to be an expert in every single tool, but you must be able to discuss technical trade-offs across the entire stack:

  • Backend: Python FastAPI), Kafka, Neo4j, LangGraph.
  • Frontend: Angular 16+, TypeScript, RxJS,
  • Data: Apache Airflow, Delta Lake, Polars/Spark.
  • Infrastructure: Kubernetes (EKS/AKS/K3s), Terraform, Hybrid Cloud

Qualifications
Desired Profile

  • The Architect-Implementer: You can draw the system architecture on a whiteboard, but you are not afraid to open an IDE to debug a failing pipeline or a slow query.
  • The Polyglot: You are likely a Backend or Full-Stack native, but you understand the complexity of Frontend state management (NgRx/Signals) and the constraints of Medallion Data Architectures.
  • Reliability Mindset: You understand that we are dealing with critical industrial environments. You prioritize testing, validation, and security.

Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities
Must Haves:

  • 10+ years of experience in Software Engineering, with at least 2+ years leading technical teams.
  • Deep proficiency in Python Backend Development.
  • Solid understanding of Frontend complexity (SPA architecture, async data loading).
  • Experience designing or managing Data Intensive Applications (understanding ETL, Streams, or Data Lakes).
  • Familiarity with DevOps/Cloud concepts (Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD).
  • Advanced English communication skills.

Good to Have:

  • Streaming: Proficiency with Streaming Technologies (Kafka, Flink, Spark) and Time-Series Databases (TimescaleDB, InfluxDB).
  • GenAI: Practical experience building applications with LLMs, Agentic Frameworks (LangGraph), and Vector Databases.
  • Graph: Hands-on experience with Graph Databases (Neo4j/Cypher), SQL database design, and Hybrid Search strategies
  • Experience with Digital Twins, IoT, or Industrial Data.
  • Experience with GenAI/LLM architecture (RAG, Agents).
  • Background in Heavy Industry, O&G, or IoT data (MQTT, OPC UA).
  • Experience with Local LLMs (Ollama) for privacy-focused deployments.
  • Familiarity with Data Lineage or Metadata management.

title: Auxiliar de Turma
description:
O Inspired é o maior grupo internacional de educação básica premium, com um portfólio de 121 escolas espalhadas pelos 6 continentes e que utilizam as melhores práticas educacionais de cada canto do mundo, garantindo uma experiência de aprendizado de qualidade máxima para mais de alunos do Infantil ao Ensino Médio.

Nossas escolas Inspired estão em 27 países e cada uma é pensada individualmente de acordo com o contexto local e é ancorada na cultura vibrante na qual se encontra. Coletivamente, elas compõem uma comunidade que nutre o desenvolvimento acadêmico e pessoal dos alunos num ambiente de aprendizagem progressivo, dinâmico e inovador.

Se juntando ao nosso time de mais de colaboradores, você poderá trabalhar em instalações de última geração ao lado de educadores e líderes renomados do setor em alguns dos lugares mais desejados do mundo. Investimos fortemente nas nossas equipes e assim cada um consegue aproveitar desenvolvimento profissional, oportunidades de carreira excepcionais e mobilidade em todo o nosso grupo.

SOBRE A VAGA

A Escola Eleva é uma das escolas Inspired no Brasil. Aqui nós temos vocação para ensinar e paixão por aprender. Nosso time é movido por excelência, entusiasmo, respeito e responsabilidade. Somos adeptos da mentalidade de crescimento e estamos constantemente motivados a buscar o que há de melhor em educação, no Brasil e no mundo e em pensar as melhores maneiras de aplicar isso em nossas escolas e inspirar nossos alunos.

Nossa missão é formar uma nova geração de líderes capazes de fazer a diferença em suas vidas e contribuir para um mundo melhor. Para isso, contamos com um time de profissionais inquietos, com brilho nos olhos e movidos por entusiasmo. Pessoas que superam desafios diariamente, com otimismo e acreditando no legado que estamos construindo.

Neste papel você será responsável pelos cuidados com os alunos de Infantil e pelo apoio em outras atividades de Operações. Deve ser uma pessoa proativa, afetuosa, cuidadosa, cordial, que possui facilidade em se comunicar e se relacionar com crianças pequenas e que é capaz de lidar com o ambiente dinâmico de uma escola.

RESPONSABILIDADES

O que você fará:

  • Acompanhar e cuidar da boa convivência entre os alunos;
  • Auxiliar o time na rotina dentro de sala;
  • Acompanhar o almoço, escovação de dentes e demais rotinas do aluno do Ensino Infantil;
  • Realizar a entrada e a saída dos alunos;
  • Organizar as salas e demais espaços;
  • Apoiar com organização e operação de eventos escolares;
  • Organizar as mochilas dos alunos;
  • Trocar a roupa dos alunos antes das atividades extras;
  • Higienizar materiais de artes (aventais, pincéis e outros);
  • Atuar em conformidade com os valores, orientações e procedimentos estabelecidos pela escola.

Por mais que nos esforcemos para incluir todas as principais responsabilidades e atribuições desta posição, pode ser que nem toda atividade pertinente à função tenha sido identificada. Dessa forma, a lista acima não é restritiva e pode ser estendida ou alterada para incluir outras tarefas que se aplicam ao cargo.

REQUISITOS

O que você precisa ter:

  • Ensino Médio Completo;
  • Experiência em cuidados com crianças.

Nossos auxiliares de turma devem ser capazes de/devem ter:

  • Estar sempre em busca de melhorias;
  • Atitude positiva frente a mudanças;
  • Preocupação e atenção genuína pelos níveis mais altos de bem-estar dos alunos.

Será um diferencial se você tiver:

  • Inglês intermediário;
  • Experiência prévia em escolas.

DECLARAÇÃO DE SALVAGUARDA

O Inspired se compromete em salvaguardar e promover o bem-estar das crianças e jovens e, se você se juntar ao nosso time, esperaremos o mesmo de você, assim como que se comprometa a realizar os treinamentos de safeguarding que consideramos pertinentes à sua função. A proteção do bem-estar dos nossos alunos é de responsabilidade de todos os colaboradores e os mesmos devem se comportar de maneira a refletir os princípios e valores da organização. Qualquer candidato pode ser submetido aos procedimentos apropriados de verificação.

Estamos procurando alguém motivado, criativo e com vontade de trazer novas ideias para entrar no nosso time de Supply Chain da Pierre Fabre Brasil.É uma ótima oportunidade de ganhar experiência nas áreas de Supply (S&OP/Customer Service/Distribuição Física) em uma grande empresa global de dermocosméticos.
Principais atividades:
Apoiar no mapeamento e desenvolvimento de projetos de melhoria contínua nas áreas de Supply;
Automatizar e otimizar bases de indicadores, garantindo maior eficiência nos processos;
Suporte em criar e manter dashboards e relatórios gerenciais para acompanhamento dos principais KPIs;
Contribuir para a gestão de mudanças e manutenção das informações da área;
Participar da preparação e apresentação de análises para suporte à tomada de decisão;
Apoiar nas rotinas do dia a dia, sempre com foco em agregar valor e propor soluções;
Colaborar entre as áreas de S&OP, Customer Service e Distribuição física.
Um pouco do que oferecemos:
Bolsa estágio;
Vale Transporte;
Vale Refeição;
Plano de Saúde e Odontológico;
Wellhub;
Seguro de Vida.
O que esperamos de você:
Curso superior em andamento em Administração, Engenharias ou cursos de ciências exatas;
Boas habilidades com o Excel e Power BI (nível avançado é um diferencial);
Inglês intermediário/avançado é um diferencial.
Perfil analítico e voltado para a solução de problemas;
Habilidades de comunicação e relacionamento interpessoal;
Atitude proativa com forte vontade de aprender e tomar iniciativas.
Quem nós somos
O Grupo Pierre Fabre tem mais de 60 anos de experiência farmacêutica e foi inventor da dermocosmética. Pioneiro no cenário industrial francês graças a sua estrutura acionária única: 86% das ações são mantidas por uma fundação de mesmo nome reconhecida como de interesse público pelo governo, enquanto o restante são propriedades de seus próprios funcionários.
Temos orgulho em ser:
O segundo maior laboratório de dermocosméticos do mundo.
O segundo maior grupo farmacêutico privado francês.
Comprometidos em fazer produtos com Conscious Care: priorizando a eficácia, segurança e naturalidade nas fórmulas.
Como é trabalhar na Pierre Fabre Brasil
No Brasil, somos mais de 450 colaboradores distribuídos por todo o país. Somos conhecidos pelas nossas três marcas de consumo: Eau Thermale Avène, Darrow e Ducray. Em 2022, fomos reconhecidos entre os melhores empregadores do mundo, pela revista Forbes, e como um ótimo lugar para se trabalhar, pela GPTW.
O Grupo Pierre Fabre é, antes de tudo, uma aventura humana. Cada colaborador partilha os mesmos valores, humanistas e autênticos, são esses:
ABRAÇAR A CAUSA do Grupo, aplicando e reforçando sua estratégia.
Buscar por sua melhor PERFORMANCE.
AGIR COMO UM, ao colaborar dentro e fora de sua equipe.
CRESCER A CADA DIA, sempre aprendendo ou desenvolvendo sua equipe.
INOVAR, trazendo soluções criativas em benefício de nossos clientes.
Construir objetivos AMBICIOSO e superar resultados.
Oferecer FEEDBACK construtivo para o sucesso coletivo da equipe e da empresa.
Ao se candidatar a esta vaga você está ciente que será necessário o fornecimento de algumas informações pessoais a seu respeito ("dados pessoais") à empresa para possibilitar sua identificação no processo seletivo, bem como para que a referida empresa possa entrar em contato com você.
A empresa não compartilhará seus dados pessoais com terceiros sem a sua autorização, a menos que seja legalmente obrigada a fazê-lo, e seus dados pessoais permanecerão armazenados pelo período máximo de 2 anos a contar da data de fornecimento, ou da última atualização de sua candidatura à vaga.
Caso você seja contratado, estes dados poderão ser armazenados por um período maior em decorrência da elaboração e execução do contrato de trabalho.
Para maiores informações sobre como é feito o tratamento de seus dados PESSOAIS, bem como seus direitos enquanto titular de dados, você pode enviar uma solicitação ao Encarregado, da Pierre Fabre.
Estamos convencidos de que a diversidade é uma fonte de realização, equilíbrio social e complementaridade para nossos funcionários, razão pela qual nossas ofertas estão abertas a todos, sem restrições.

title: Programa de Desenvolvimento Acelerado de Estágio - PDA 2026 | Rio de Janeiro/RJ
description:
Vem ser RJZ Cyrela e transforme o futuro com a gente

Na RJZ Cyrela, transformamos espaços e criamos experiências únicas que encantam e inspiram. Com mais de 60 anos de história, estamos sempre em busca de inovação e sustentabilidade, oferecendo soluções diferenciadas no setor imobiliário. Valorizamos o potencial das pessoas e acreditamos que, juntos, podemos construir um futuro melhor. Se você é apaixonado por transformar, colaborar e fazer a diferença, venha fazer parte do impossível, que para nós não é só um ponto de vista, e sim um ponto de partida.

O Programa de Desenvolvimento Acelerado de Estágio - PDA da RJZ Cyrela, conta com:

  • Job Rotation no escritório entre as áreas do Administrativo Financeiro, Incorporação e Novos Negócios/Terrenos. Sendo do Administrativo Financeiro: Backoffice de Vendas, Cobrança, Controladoria, Registro e Repasse; nos times de Incorporação RJZ Cyrela, Living e Vivaz, e no time de Novos Negócios/Terrenos. No Financeiro o job rotation preferencialmente é feito a cada 6 meses, e no time de Incorporação após 12 meses pela estrutura do ciclo do negócio para que você consiga entender toda a esteira do negócio e no time de Terrenos geralmente após 1 ao e meio pela estrutura do ciclo do negócio. O seu job rotation pode começar em uma dessas áreas e depois rodar, ela varia conforme as oportunidades internas e seu perfil. A rotação em diversas áreas lhe possibilita tornar um profissional mais capacitado e com diversos conhecimentos sobre as atividades da empresa. Além disso terá acompanhamento de resolução de projetos e apadrinhamento. Valorizamos seu jeito de ser e de pensar. Acreditamos e investimos no seu potencial
  • Apadrinhamento: a relação entre padrinho/madrinha e estagiário é uma via de mão dupla que colabora para ambas as partes e a organização. É um investimento de tempo e esforço que produz frutos duradouros, moldando não apenas carreiras, mas também vidas. Nossos padrinhos/madrinhas escolhidos para o PDA, estão preparados para reconhecer o potencial do outro e trabalhar ativamente para realizá-lo.
  • Trilha de formação: com o objetivo de impulsionar o desenvolvimento profissional e pessoal, além de fortalecer a formação dentro da Companhia, contamos com um cronograma anual focado no aprimoramento de soft e hard skills. A programação inclui visitas às obras, encontros "Café com Carreira" com ex-estagiários que hoje ocupam posições de liderança e na Diretoria, projetos colaborativos com desafios reais da Companhia, entre outras ações especiais.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

O que espera por você no seu dia a dia:

No time do Financeiro:

  • Verificação e acompanhamento do fluxo de caixa e viabilidade dos empreendimentos;
  • Elaboração e análise de relatórios de performance de processos;
  • Análise de crédito e aprovação de proposta de vendas;
  • Gerenciamento do estoque de imóveis à venda;
  • Controle da base de dados relacionados às áreas do financeiro;
  • Melhoria de processos.

No time de Novos Negócios/Terrenos:

  • Auxiliar na avaliação dos terrenos de acordo com os interesses da empresa;
  • Auxiliar na elaboração do estudo de viabilidade econômica do terreno apurando a rentabilidade do negócio, com o objetivo de subsidiar a empresa com informações para tomada de decisão;
  • Acompanhar serviços técnicos necessários antes da compra do terreno.

No time de Incorporação:

  • Auxiliar na elaborar os estudos de viabilidade de lançamento, com base na análise e otimização dos projetos do produto, interagindo com as áreas de desenvolvimento de produto e projeto legal, visando manter a rentabilidade projetada na compra do terreno;
  • Contribuir para a aceleração dos processos para aprovação do projeto legal junto aos órgãos competentes, bem como para o registro do memorial de incorporação, através do atendimento de todas as exigências (projeto, documentação, convenção de condomínio, NBR, etc.), acompanhando os processos a fim de garantir o cumprimento do prazo de lançamento;
  • Manter contato com os parceiros e as áreas internas ligadas ao empreendimento, buscando informações e aprovações;
  • Participar das campanhas de marketing, através de análise e sugestões, visando enaltecer o produto para contribuir na meta de lançamento;
  • Apoiar a área de vendas, através da elaboração da tabela de vendas e apoio ao corpo de vendas, esclarecendo dúvidas quanto ao produto e às condições de vendas, bem como participando no treinamento de capacitação dos corretores;
  • Acompanhar a contratação de serviços que são realizados no terreno antes da obra iniciar.

Requisitos e qualificações

O que esperamos de você:

  • Buscamos estagiários engajados, proativos, colaborativos, que façam a diferença e que queiram crescer junto conosco;
  • Cursando Engenharia Civil ou Produção, Economia ou Administração, com previsão de formatura para Julho/2028 à Dezembro/2028;
  • Disponibilidade para trabalhar 30 horas semanais, presencial na Barra da Tijuca.

Vai ser um diferencial se você:

  • Possuir conhecimento em excel e noções de outras ferramentas de análise de dados.

Informações adicionais

Horário de Trabalho: Segunda à Sexta: 6h diárias presenciais.

Local: Avenida das Américas, Barra da Tijuca. Rio de Janeiro/RJ

title: Intelligence Analyst
description:
Overview

170 Years Strong. Industry Leader. Global Impact.At Pinkerton, the mission is to protect our clients. To do this, we provide enterprise risk management services and programs specifically designed for each client. Pinkerton employees are one of our most important assets and critical to the delivery of world-class solutions. Bonded together, we share a commitment to integrity, vigilance, and excellence.

Pinkerton is an inclusive employer who seeks candidates with diverse backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives to join our family of industry subject matter experts.

The Intelligence Analyst, assigned to a specific client, will monitor, evaluate, and interpret data from various sources to identify threats and risks that may affect the company, its employees, or reputation. The Analyst produces timely intelligence through event and trend analysis, supports crisis response, and provides actionable insights for decision-making.

Responsibilities

  • Represent Pinkerton's core values of integrity, vigilance, and excellence.
  • Monitor open sources (OSINT) including press, intelligence subscriptions, social media to identify threats/risks that may impact the client's operations, employees, and reputation.
  • Manage the collection of intelligence information used to populate situational reports and risk assessments.
  • Collaborate with internal teams and external partners to gather intelligence and insights on threat actors, their tactics, techniques, and procedures (TTPs).
  • Regularly update threat profiles to reflect the latest information and changes in the threat landscape.
  • Support executive protection and travel security by proving threat assessments and reporting.
  • Assist with the periodic updating of standard operational procedures (SOPs), produce After Action Reports, and create playbooks and risk matrices to strengthen organizational resilience.
  • Establish and maintain systematic, cross referenced intelligence records and files.
  • Initiate, execute, and maintain intelligence relationships inside and outside the organization.
  • Safeguard and maintain highly sensitive and confidential information.
  • All other duties, as assigned.

Qualifications

Bachelor's degree with 3 years of risk analysis and/or intelligence experience.

  • Bilingual written and verbal skills; English and Portuguese. Spanish is optional.
  • Knowledge and understanding of intelligence-gathering techniques.
  • Able to identify risks by analyzing data and information from multiple unrelated sources into a finished comprehensive intelligence product.
  • Client orientated and results driven.
  • Able to work independently with little supervision and under adverse and stressful conditions.
  • Able to present and defend intelligence positions to a variety of audiences and stakeholders.
  • Able to interact collaboratively at all levels of an organization.
  • Serve as a positive team member.
  • Maintain confidentiality when dealing with sensitive information.
  • Able to manage multiple projects simultaneously with competing priorities and deadlines.
  • Computer skills; Microsoft Office.

Working Conditions:

With or without reasonable accommodation, requires the physical and mental capacity to effectively perform all essential functions;

  • Regular computer usage.
  • Occasional reaching and lifting of small objects and operating office equipment.
  • Frequent sitting.
  • Travel, as required.

Pinkerton is an equal opportunity employer to all applicants and positions without regard to race/ethnicity, color, national origin, ancestry, sex/gender, gender identity/expression, sexual orientation, marital/prenatal status, pregnancy/childbirth or related conditions, religion, creed, age, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any protected status by local, state, federal or country-specific law.

title: Gestor(a) Sênior de Projetos — Dados
description:
Missão do cargo

Orquestrar o portfólio de projetos da coordenação de Dados & IA do início ao fim, assegurando entregas com qualidade e alinhadas à estratégia da diretoria e das áreas de negócio. Por que este papel é crítico
• Este profissional vai nos ajudar no gerenciamento da fila de demandas, facilitando na estimativa de prazos e garantindo a documentação de tarefas para rastreabilidade no Azure DevOps.
• Ele vai fazer a conexão ponta a ponta, atuando como hub entre o time de IA e Dados e os times de negócio e/ou fornecedores, removendo impedimentos com senso de urgência.

Principais responsabilidades

1) Gestão de projetos e resultados
• Conduzir projetos com definição de escopo, riscos, dependências, prioridades e cronogramas.
• Apresentar status executivo semanal para a coordenação de IA e Dados, mostrando avanços, riscos e próximos passos. Além de promover planos de ação em caso de desvios.
• Acompanhar diariamente os responsáveis por cada entrega e cobrar por qualidade e prazo, com gestão por marcos (milestones).

2) Governança e monitoramento no Azure DevOps
• Manter um backlog de demandas centralizado no Azure DevOps; apoiar na escrita de épicos, features, histórias e tasks, definindo critérios de aceitação claros.
• Construir dashboards executivos, queries e KPIs para monitorar cadência de tarefas e balanceamento de carga de trabalho.
• Garantir documentação e rastreabilidade de tarefas no Azure DevOps.

3) Remoção de impedimentos e gestão de riscos
• Alinhas expectativas com pontos focais do negócio sobre escopo, objetivos, prioridades e expectativas.
• Acionar os times de Dados, Infraestrutura e Cyber segurança para desbloquear dependências, caso existam.
• Antecipar riscos e estabelecer planos de ação antes que impactem o cronograma

Requisitos:

Requisitos obrigatórios

JD — Gestor(a) Sênior de Projetos | Dados & IA

  • 5+ anos em gestão de projetos de Dados & IA.
  • Sólida vivência em projetos de pipelines de dados, integrações, automações, ingestão/transformação de dados, modelos de dados e modelagem preditiva.
  • Domínio de Azure DevOps (backlog, queries, relatórios e dashboards).
  • Experiência em gestão de fornecedores e contratos.


• Capacidade de traduzir demandas de negócio em histórias/tarefas.
• Comunicação executiva, negociação e relacionamento com stakeholders.

Diferencial


• Experiência prévia na indústria de óleo e gás. Competências comportamentais — o que mais buscamos
• Pragmatismo e foco em entrega.
• Senso de urgência (age rápido para remover bloqueios).
• Clareza executiva (sintetiza riscos/decisões para diretoria).
• Negociação e influência (comunicação clara com múltiplos stakeholders e terceiros).
• Visão de negócio com repertório técnico em Dados & IA (traduz problema em backlog viável). Métricas esperadas (operacionais e de fluxo)
• Burndown trend por sprint/iteração.
• Lead time e padronização de fluxos de trabalho no Azure DevOps. Modelo de trabalho
• Presencial.

Fundada em 1977 como "Cardiolab", atualmente conta com 75 hospitais próprios e 3 sob gestão, além de 55 clínicas oncológicas, nos estados do RJ, SP, MG, PE, BA, MA, SE, CE, AL, PB, PR, MS, PA e DF.

Gerencia diferentes marcas, tendo presença mais marcante no Rio de Janeiro, com a marca "D'Or"; em SP, com "São Luiz"; em PE, com "Esperança"; no DF, com "Santa Luzia" e "Santa Helena"; no MA, com "UDI"; na BA, com "São Rafael"; em SE, com "São Lucas"; no PR, com "Santa Cruz"; em MG, com "Biocor", em MS, com "Proncor", em PB, com "Nossa Senhora das Neves", em CE com "São Carlos", além da marca premium "Star" nos estados do RJ, SP e DF.

Em 23 de dezembro de 2022, a proposta de valor da Rede D'Or foi reforçada significativamente com a consumação da combinação de negócios com a SulAmérica – a maior seguradora do Brasil e uma das maiores operadoras de saúde do país. Com atuação nos segmentos de seguro saúde e odonto, vida e acidentes pessoais, gestão de ativos e previdência privada, a SulAmérica conta com mais de 4 mil pessoas colaboradoras e possui mais de 7 milhões de clientes distribuídos por todo Brasil.

Acreditamos na responsabilidade em contribuir para uma sociedade mais justa, inclusiva e com igualdade de oportunidades, por isso, todas as nossas vagas estão abertas a pessoas de diferentes perfis e contextos, inclusive pessoas com deficiência.

Se você é uma pessoa qualificada, de perfil inovador e sintonizada com o que há de mais atual em sua área de atuação, junte-se à nossa equipe.

Oferecemos mais que vagas de trabalho, oferecemos oportunidades para você fazer a diferença.

At Alignerr, we partner with the world's leading AI research teams and labs to build and train cutting-edge AI models.
Identity sits at the core of most modern security failures, and we're looking for people who understand how and why identity systems break in real environments. You will work with realistic identity and access scenarios to help ensure AI systems learn how IAM risk actually emerges and propagates.

What You'll Do
Analyze IAM, SSO, and access control scenarios to identify weaknesses and misconfigurations
Classify permission issues, privilege escalation paths, and identity-related failures

Help generate and validate realistic identity security data used to train and evaluate AI systems
What We're Looking For
2+ years working with IAM, SSO, or enterprise identity platforms
Familiarity with RBAC, least-privilege models, and access review processes
Understanding of how identity failures occur and how attackers exploit them
Why Join Us
Competitive pay and flexible remote work.
Work directly on frontier AI systems.
Freelance perks: autonomy, flexibility, and global collaboration.
Potential for contract extension.

title: Program Officer - 25431-FT_LT
description:
WIPO Brazil Office, Regional and National Development Sector
Contract Duration - 2 years (maximum cumulative length of 5 years) *
Duty Station: BR-Rio de Janeiro
Application Deadline: 11-Feb-2026, 11:59:00 PM CET
IMPORTANT NOTICE REGARDING APPLICATION DEADLINE: please note that the deadline for applications is indicated in local time as per the time zone of the applicant's location.
This post is a limited-term fixed-term post.
1. Organizational Context
a. Organizational Setting
The post is located in the WIPO Brazil Office (WBO).
The WBO is part of a network of WIPO External Offices that add clear value, efficiency and effectiveness to the delivery of WIPO's programs, in line with its Strategic Goals and Results Framework, in a coordinated and complimentary way with WIPO Headquarters.
The WBO assists the Brazilian government, IP professionals, creators, innovators, businesses and communities in Brazil create value from IP through the use of WIPO treaties, services and global databases, platforms, tools, and products, as well as through the design and implementation of impactful projects and initiatives on the ground. The WBO also works to increase awareness on the importance of strengthening the Brazilian IP and Innovation ecosystem for economic, social and cultural development.
b. Purpose Statement
The Program Officer is responsible for providing technical guidance and supporting the development and implementation of project-based initiatives for Brazil. The Program Officer is responsible for ensuring close liaison and cooperation with the Brazilian authorities and other stakeholders in the country to extend the reach and impact of WIPO's support at the national, institutional and community level. The Program Officer also supports the Director of the WBO in ensuring the efficient and effective operations and management of the Office and its close and integrated functioning with WIPO Headquarters.
c. Reporting Lines
The Program Officer works under the supervision of the Director of the WBO.
d. Work Relations
The Program Officer liaises closely with Sectors, Divisions and work units in Headquarters, in particular with the Department of Development Cooperation and the Division for External Offices Coordination, connecting WIPO's cooperation assistance modalities, services, databases, tools, platforms and products with beneficiaries in Brazil in a coordinated, effective and efficient manner.
2. Duties and Responsibilities
The incumbent will perform the following principal duties:
a. Research and analyze specific data on how IP could support the development priorities for Brazil, identify new project opportunities, formulate and present project proposals providing technical and substantive input, and manage and monitor the administrative and operational activities of approved projects.
b. Design and implement capacity building programs and activities providing financial and technical support for such initiatives, coordinate with different sectors within the Organization and with external stakeholders and partners.
c. Engage with the Brazilian authorities and key national stakeholders (such as business associations, universities and research institutions, professional associations and representative bodies, civil society, innovators and creators) to design and implement projects and activities that address national needs across the country.
d. Liaise with United Nations institutions in Brazil on matters of common system interest to build synergies for mandate implementation.
e. Represent WIPO at national meetings and participate in missions and briefings to identify opportunities for and further mandate implementation.
f. Prepare reports and documents, including performance updated, progress on mandate implementation, financial results, as well as internal memoranda, draft agreements and other working documents to support reporting requirements.
g. Promote WIPO's strategies and plans that would ensure greater and more effective use of WIPO's Global IP services through targeted outreach to existing and potential users and establishment of partnerships.
h. Assist in the administration and management of the Office, including contributing to the monitoring of financial flows in line with organizational rules and regulations.
i. Perform other related duties as required.
3. Requirements
Education (Essential)
First-level university degree in law, economics, international relations, development studies or a related field.
Education (Desirable)
Advanced university degree in the above fields or a specialization in IP.
Experience (Essential)
At least six years' relevant professional experience in intellectual property, including copyright and creative economy.
Experience in project design and management.
Experience working with the Brazilian IP, innovation, and creative ecosystem.
Professional experience in international cooperation programs.
Language (Essential)
Excellent knowledge of written and spoken Portuguese and English.
Language (Desirable)
Knowledge of other UN language preferably Spanish.
Job Related Competencies (Essential)
Competent understanding and use of RBM frameworks in planning, monitoring, and evaluating projects and programmatic activities.
Ability to coordinate full project/program lifecycles, including administration of budget and financial resources.
Strong analytical thinking, organizational abilities, and planning skills, with a focus on effective progress tracking and reporting.
Strong digital literacy and adaptability in using a wide range of tools and platforms.
Excellent diplomatic skills and ability to work with tact and discretion.
Excellent drafting skills.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to foster and maintain effective partnerships and working relations in a multi-cultural environment and with a variety of stakeholders with sensitivity and respect for diversity.
Ability to work with limited supervision and take initiative while respecting Organizational regulations and rules.
Familiarity with IP concepts, including copyright and industrial property, and their relevance in project contexts.
Job Related Competencies (Desirable)
Good understanding of WIPO's international registration systems.
4. Organizational Competencies
1. Communicating effectively.
2. Showing team spirit.
3. Demonstrating integrity.
4. Valuing diversity.
5. Producing results.
6. Showing service orientation.
7. Seeing the big picture.
8. Seeking change and innovation.
9. Developing yourself and others.
For more information, including on the salaries and benefits, please check the WIPO Careers website.

title: Head Of Event Services
description:
FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women's sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women's World Cup 2027 ("FWWC2027") that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

The Head of Event Services shall have dual reporting to the Event Services Director in FIFA HQ Zurich and to the Executive Operations Director. Under the leadership of the FIFA HQ team, they shall ensure the successful operational planning, management and implementation of the Accommodation, Travel, Logistics, Transport and Guest Operations projects for the FIFA Women's World Cup ("FWWC").

The Head of Event Services will work together with the Event Services Team in FIFA HQ Zurich to ensure:

  1. Drive FIFA's leadership in Event Services, encompassing the above areas.

  2. Ensure suitable and efficient business models and processes for operation across multiple different events, of different scales, simultaneously, across all areas under auspice.

3.Continuously assess and propose improvements to the requirements and regulations for the services. Integrate these enhancements into the Master Project Plans and detailed budgets, ensuring stakeholder alignment and cost-effective delivery for each event within the FIFA Women's World Cup 2027 project.

  1. Follow the trends of the industry to be ready to anticipate changes in a responsible and timely manner.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Operational Excellence and Project Delivery:

  • Plan and execute projects and services, ensuring they are delivered on time, within scope, and within budget, while maintaining high-quality standards.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for the Executive Operations Director regarding all service-related matters, representing the Director on various occasions as needed.
  • Develop and implement efficient project plans and procedures for all tournaments and events in collaboration with other Subdivisions, ensuring seamless execution.

Collaboration and Team Integration:

  • Contribute to the overall success of the FIFA Women's World Cup 2027as an active member of the management team, fostering strong collaboration across FIFA27.
  • Ensure the Event Services department consistently delivers high-quality services to tournament project teams, positioning itself as a key service provider.
  • Collaborate with other departments to share responsibility for the FWWC's overall success, ensuring alignment with broader goals and objectives, and maintaining a focus on the big picture.

Stakeholder Engagement and Networking:

  • Cultivate close cooperation with staff members across all divisions to ensure an exceptional user experience (UX). This includes coordinating with FIFA stakeholders, local FIFA subsidiaries, stadium/venue owners, host associations, local authorities, and third-party partners to create optimal conditions.

  • Share relevant information within the FIFA27 and with other internal and external stakeholders to ensure effective communication and collaboration

  • Independent and Flexible: Ability to lead large teams independently in complex environments, and situations with ambiguity

  • Effective Communication and Trust Building: Skilled in fostering open communication and creating an environment of trust. Capable of understanding and addressing the needs and expectations of others, identifying and resolving conflicts, and delivering impactful presentations. Experienced negotiator in an international context
  • Client-Centric Approach: Consistently demonstrates respect and professionalism toward clients (colleagues, superiors, member associations, clubs, etc.). Clearly defines and aligns expectations, ensuring client needs are met and exceeded. Receives positive client feedback, builds strong, trusting relationships, and anticipates client needs. Maintains a flexible and innovative mindset in service delivery
  • Leadership and Team Development: Respected leader within the team, setting ambitious objectives and motivating staff to achieve them. Inspires collaboration and fosters a high-performance culture. Well-regarded by peers and top management, adapting goals to client needs and driving continuous improvement. Effectively manages pressure, supports team growth, and handles challenges with strong interpersonal and conflict-resolution skills
  • Strategic Thinking: Demonstrates the ability to assess the broader impact of organizational decisions and developments, anticipating their consequences.
  • Decisive Action and Risk Management: Recognizes situations that require swift, pragmatic decision-making. Takes initiative, explores various solutions, and is willing to take calculated risks. Acts promptly and decisively in response to unexpected challenges.
  • Planning and Resource Management: Skilled in developing detailed, chronological plans, setting priorities, and allocating resources effectively. Implements systems for tracking progress and control, and adapts plans as needed to achieve objectives. Maintains a strong focus on reporting and accountability.
  • Collaboration in a Multi-National Team: Leads and collaborates effectively in diverse, cross-cultural teams. Navigates cultural differences, fosters inclusivity, and ensures seamless communication across global teams, driving alignment and achieving shared goals.
  • A minimum sports event management experience of 5 years, ideally on an international level in the Event Services (Accommodation, Travel, Logistics, Transport and Guest Operations).
  • Extensive knowledge of event and sport facility operations
  • Strong knowledge of event planning and event project management processes
  • Strong administrative and IT skills including MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint)
  • Ability to effectively monitor organisational performance and implement decisive corrective actions
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro soon.

title: Deal Quality Specialist
description:
This position requires full relocation to Saudi Arabia. It is a permanent full time Expat Relocation Package.
Job Overview
We are seeking an Deal Quality Specialist to join Strategy & Business Development Division (SBDD) within the Gas Venture Department.
SBDD is responsible for sourcing and developing international gas value chain (upstream, liquefaction, marketing, regasification) investment opportunities. The Division is also responsible for coordinating the execution of these investment opportunities and managing investments post transaction, with an objective of creating a viable, material integrated global gas business by 2035.
Your primary role, as part on the economics modeling team, is to support the commercial business development team who develops the supply side of the LNG business and will lead the economic evaluation of LNG projects in terms of plant investment and offtake trading for investment decision making. Additionally, you will be required to engage with support functions such as Treasury, Group Finance and Strategy & Market Analysis as part of the model sign-off and due diligence process.
Key Responsibilities
As the successful candidate you will be required to perform the following:
Screen upstream gas and Liquefied Natural Gas (LNG) investment opportunities globally.
Identify project opportunities available.
Screen opportunities coming from internal screening, i.e., monitoring of the global market, reserves, possible expansions of existing projects, and Screen opportunities coming from external proposals through communication with gas & LNG players.
Characterize the opportunities and prioritize them through set of defined criteria (e.g., Upstream potential, project maturity, quality of potential partners, project economics and local policies, identification of key areas pending to take Final Investment Decision (FID).
Handle complex deal structures, with the development and interpretation of data used in a highly technical and confidential analysis platform.
Assess pre-FID projects and coordinate M&A task force.
Coordinate M&A task force to collect inputs from different units (Upstream, Gas Ventures Department Origination, Legal to support assessment of pre-FID projects).
Conduct negotiations with partners to finalize investment terms, and execute transactions.
Manage technical, financial, commercial, environmental and legal due diligences.
Manage external advisors on the assessment process.
Identify alternative investments for Gas Ventures Department (GVD).
Explore and assess acquisition of stake in existing or FID projects.
Support decision making at management level with reports on specific opportunities.
Coordinate communication on LNG & gas opportunities across the organization.
Provide Market Intelligence with inputs on focus areas and request ad-hoc analyses required for specific project assessments.
Provide all necessary inputs for contract negotiations and management for specific projects, at the same time involving Origination in M&A task force.
Minimum Requirements
As the successful candidate you will have the following:
You will hold a Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance or Engineering from a recognized and approved program. MBA or other advanced Post Graduate degree in MPA or a business-related degree is preferred.
You must have a minimum of 15 years of experience with 10 years of relevant M&A and business development, transactions, Gas & LNG work experience, preferably in a major petrochemical or energy industry corporation.
You will be able to demonstrate leadership and management experience.
You will have a strong ability to establish and maintain networks, both within and across company organizations is Necessary.
Capability to work effectively within a matrix organization and with multi-disciplinary teams is also preferred.
Working Environment
Our high-performing employees are drawn by the challenging and rewarding professional, technical and industrial opportunities we offer, and are remunerated accordingly.
At Aramco, our people work on truly world-scale projects, supported by investment in capital and technology that is second to none. And because, as a global energy company, we are faced with addressing some of the world's biggest technical, logistical and environmental challenges, we invest heavily in talent development.
We have a proud history of educating and training our workforce over many decades. Employees at all levels are encouraged to improve their sector-specific knowledge and competencies through our workforce development programs – one of the largest in the world.
Aramco energizes the world economy.
Aramco occupies a special position in the global energy industry. We are one of the world's largest producers of hydrocarbon energy and chemicals, with among the lowest Upstream carbon intensities of any major producer.
With our significant investment in technology and infrastructure, we strive to maximize the value of the energy we produce for the world along with a commitment to enhance Aramco's value to society.
Headquartered in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, and with offices around the world, we combine market discipline with a generations' spanning view of the future, born of our nine decades experience as responsible stewards of the Kingdom's vast hydrocarbon resources. This responsibility has driven us to deliver significant societal and economic benefits to not just the Kingdom, but also to a vast number of communities, economies, and countries that rely on the vital and reliable energy that we supply.
We are one of the most profitable companies in the world, as well as amongst the top five global companies by market capitalization.

Fundada em 1977 como "Cardiolab", atualmente conta com 75 hospitais próprios e 3 sob gestão, além de 55 clínicas oncológicas, nos estados do RJ, SP, MG, PE, BA, MA, SE, CE, AL, PB, PR, MS, PA e DF.

Em 23 de dezembro de 2022, a proposta de valor da Rede D'Or foi reforçada significativamente com a consumação da combinação de negócios com a SulAmérica – a maior seguradora do Brasil e uma das maiores operadoras de saúde do país. Com atuação nos segmentos de seguro saúde e odonto, vida e acidentes pessoais, gestão de ativos e previdência privada, a SulAmérica conta com mais de 4 mil pessoas colaboradoras e possui mais de 7 milhões de clientes distribuídos por todo Brasil.

Acreditamos na responsabilidade em contribuir para uma sociedade mais justa, inclusiva e com igualdade de oportunidades, por isso, todas as nossas vagas estão abertas a pessoas de diferentes perfis e contextos, inclusive pessoas com deficiência.
